query: What share of the revenue of the government of Peru went to paying interest on its debt in 2019?

text.text: Identifies the interest-to-revenue ratio (interest paid by general government as a share of government revenue, i.e. interest as % of GDP divided by revenue as % of GDP) as the applicable burden measure of repayment capacity (IMF 2013 Staff Guidance Note: debt burden indicators scale debt or debt service by GDP or government revenues).
text.accept: full = interest/revenue in percent; partial = uses total debt service (interest plus amortisation) or interest/GDP; no = debt-to-revenue or debt-to-GDP.

data.text: Uses general government revenue and grants (% GDP) and interest paid = primary balance minus overall balance (% GDP) (WEO Oct 2025: GGR_NGDP, GGXONLB_NGDP, GGXCNL_NGDP).
data.accept: full = all inputs correctly sourced; partial = some inputs approximated; no = unrelated series.

computation.text: The value for Peru in 2019 is about 5.9 % of revenue.
computation.accept: full = within +-0.5; partial = within +-1; no = otherwise.

grading.note: Verdicts exact. Convention for the gold (WEO Oct 2025, general government): interest paid = primary balance minus overall balance (% of GDP); revenue = general government revenue and grants (GGR_NGDP, % of GDP); interest-to-revenue = interest / revenue x 100; debt-to-revenue = end-of-year gross debt (% of GDP) / revenue (% of GDP) x 100, in percent of revenue.
grading.definitions: Convention for the gold (WEO Oct 2025, general government): interest paid = primary balance minus overall balance (% of GDP); revenue = general government revenue and grants (GGR_NGDP, % of GDP); interest-to-revenue = interest / revenue x 100; debt-to-revenue = end-of-year gross debt (% of GDP) / revenue (% of GDP) x 100, in percent of revenue.

provenance.method_text: IMF 2013 Staff Guidance Note (annex on stress tests: debt-burden indicators; MAC DSA template debt-to-revenue)

published_value_note: No corpus report states this country-year value for the identity on the frozen vintage; formula printed in the method document (gate a), inputs public (b), gold by script (c).
distractors: present-value-of-debt-to-revenue indicators from the low-income-country framework
answer_summary: PER 2019: interest 1.16% GDP, revenue 19.45% GDP, debt 26.5% GDP -> int/rev 5.9%, debt/rev 136.2%. Gold 5.9
